# TOAST UI Editor 3.2.2

Vendored for offline use; usage statistics are disabled in app.js.

- Browser bundle: https://uicdn.toast.com/editor/3.2.2/toastui-editor-all.min.js
- Styles and Simplified Chinese locale: @toast-ui/editor@3.2.2 npm package.
- Upstream: https://github.com/nhn/tui.editor
- License: LICENSE-toastui.txt. Bundled third-party license notices are retained in the JavaScript bundle.

The CSS files retain upstream content (not minified despite the local filenames).
